deleteDialog.title: Delete Payment
deleteDialog.message: Are you sure you want to delete this payment? This action cannot be undone.
deleteDialog.messageWithRelated: Are you sure you want to delete this payment? All related data (receivals, documents) will also be deleted. This action cannot be undone.

markPaidDialog.balanceMessage: This will register a receival for the remaining balance of {{amount}} and mark the payment as fully paid.
markPaidDialog.notesPlaceholder: Add any notes about this payment...

tooltips.sendReminder: Email the tenant about this payment
tooltips.formalNotice: Download a dated formal demand letter for this payment

selection.selectAll: Select all unpaid on this page

arrears.title: Arrears
arrears.remindersDisabled: Reminders require both the contract flag and the tenant’s consent — enable them on the contract and the contact.

bulkMarkPaidDialog.title: Mark {{count}} payments as paid
bulkMarkPaidDialog.message: Each selected payment is marked fully paid on the chosen date. Payments that are already paid or cancelled are skipped.

sendReminderDialog.title: Send payment reminder
sendReminderDialog.message: The tenant receives an email with the outstanding balance, due date and your payment instructions, in the language of the contract.
sendReminderDialog.messageBulk: Each tenant receives an email with their outstanding balance, due date and your payment instructions. Payments without a tenant email address are skipped.
sendReminderDialog.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Please transfer the amount before Friday.

FRIENDLY.label: Friendly
FRIENDLY.help: A polite nudge that the payment is open.

FIRM.label: Firm
FIRM.help: A clear demand naming the days overdue and the consequences.

FINAL.label: Final notice
FINAL.help: Formal demand with a 14-day deadline. A signed formal-notice PDF is attached and filed under the contract.

reminders.title: Reminders sent
reminders.emptySubtitle: Reminders you send to the tenant will appear here

cancelDialog.title: Cancel payment
cancelDialog.message: The payment is marked as cancelled and no longer counts as outstanding. Payments with registered receivals cannot be cancelled — write off the balance instead.
cancelDialog.messageBulk: Each selected open payment is cancelled with this reason. Paid payments and payments with receivals are skipped.
cancelDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Tenant moved out on the 15th

waiveDialog.title: Waive late fee
waiveDialog.message: The fee of {{amount}} is cancelled and will not be charged.

writeOffDialog.title: Write off balance
writeOffDialog.message: The remaining {{amount}} is closed without money received. This is recorded as a write-off and cannot be undone.
writeOffDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Bad debt after tenant left

applyCreditDialog.title: Apply tenant credit
applyCreditDialog.message: Open balance: {{balance}}. Choose which credit to use and how much of it.
applyCreditDialog.none: This tenant has no open credit in this currency.

paymentPlanDialog.title: Create payment plan
paymentPlanDialog.message: {{count}} payments with {{total}} outstanding are settled into a plan and replaced by instalments.
paymentPlanDialog.pauseReminders: Pause tenant reminders until the last instalment
paymentPlanDialog.pauseRemindersHelp: Recommended: the tenant is paying as agreed, so the ladder should not chase them.
